prompts.label: A — Warm Library
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity proposed Android home/library screen for the existing reading app "Read Assist". This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of a shipped feature. ONE straight-on smartphone screen in a very thin dark rounded frame, fully visible, centered, very large on a clean presentation canvas. Portrait composition around 1024x1536. No angled device, hands, desk props, landscape photos behind the device, or overlapping phones. Fit the complete UI including status bar and bottom navigation. Crisp, exceptionally readable English UI text, calm spacing, realistic 48dp touch targets, restrained iconography, practical native Compose/Material styling. Use fictional sample document titles only. No real commercial book covers, no authors, avatars, bookstore, recommendations, subscriptions, streaks, scores, invented reading minutes, dashboards, or technical speech-engine settings. Use "Read Assist" as the app name. Three bottom navigation destinations labeled exactly "Library", "Voices", "Settings"; Library is active. A "+" action labeled "Add" imports PDF/image or webpage via a sheet, but show sheet closed. Document overflow uses a small three-dot menu, not exposed delete buttons. Page indicator is saved page location, not completion percentage. Preserve legibility and clear contrast. Outside the device use a small concept caption and a small footer "Design preview · Sample content". App content must not contain commentary about implementation.
Direction A: Warm Library. Elegant, book-like, premium and quiet. Ivory background #F7F3EB, rich forest green #234C3D primary buttons, charcoal text, fine warm gray dividers, muted terracotta and sage book art. Serif display heading, clean sans-serif utility text. Mostly flat surfaces with very subtle depth. A substantial visual redesign, not a generic stack of identical cards.
Layout top-to-bottom:
Android status bar. App header "Read Assist" and a small outlined "＋ Add" button. Large tasteful serif headline "Your library". Full-width subtle search field "Search your library".
Small section label "CONTINUE READING". One spacious pale sage feature card: upright original abstract book cover, title "The Art of Attention", "PDF · Page 42 of 180", a slim location progress line, and a clear forest-green pill "Continue" with a right arrow. The thumbnail has simple organic terracotta/cream shapes and the same title, no author. Feature card occupies roughly a quarter of screen.
"Your documents" heading with unobtrusive filter icon at right. Compact filter chips "All", "PDFs", "Articles", "Images" with All selected. Two-column shelf showing two large readable original cover thumbnails: "A Field Guide to Nature" with botanical line art on muted moss, and "Ideas Worth Keeping" with restrained geometric ochre art. Beneath each cover: title, then "PDF · 96 pages" and "Article · 8 pages". Small overflow icons beside titles. Do not duplicate the featured book on the shelf. Make covers feel like document previews rather than products for sale.
Clean fixed bottom navigation Library / Voices / Settings. No second Home destination. No media bar in this paused-library state.
Outside phone at top: "A  WARM LIBRARY". Beautiful balanced spacing, polished but realistic to implement.

prompts.label: B — Modern Focus
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity proposed Android home/library screen for the existing reading app "Read Assist". This is a design proposal, not a screenshot of a shipped feature. ONE straight-on smartphone screen in a very thin dark rounded frame, fully visible, centered, very large on a clean presentation canvas. Portrait composition around 1024x1536. No angled device, hands, desk props, landscape photos behind the device, or overlapping phones. Fit the complete UI including status bar and bottom navigation. Crisp, exceptionally readable English UI text, calm spacing, realistic 48dp touch targets, restrained iconography, practical native Compose/Material styling. Use fictional sample document titles only. No real commercial book covers, no authors, avatars, bookstore, recommendations, subscriptions, streaks, scores, invented reading minutes, dashboards, or technical speech-engine settings. Use "Read Assist" as the app name. Three bottom navigation destinations labeled exactly "Library", "Voices", "Settings"; Library is active. A "+" action labeled "Add" imports PDF/image or webpage via a sheet, but show sheet closed. Document overflow uses a small three-dot menu, not exposed delete buttons. Page indicator is saved page location, not completion percentage. Preserve legibility and clear contrast. Outside the device use a small concept caption and a small footer "Design preview · Sample content". App content must not contain commentary about implementation.
Direction B: Modern Focus. Bright, precise document-first interface: almost-white background #F6F8FC, white panels, deep navy text, restrained cobalt blue #3456D1 accent. Sans-serif typography throughout, strong clear hierarchy. This must differ structurally from a bookshelf: compact resume strip and a spacious vertical document list with useful scan-friendly columns, not a grid of big covers.
Layout top-to-bottom:
Android status bar. Header "Read Assist" with small search icon. Large bold heading "Library", text "Books, documents and articles" underneath. A strong blue rounded "＋ Add" button aligned alongside the heading area. Search field "Search your library".
Thin horizontal blue-tinted resume panel labeled "CONTINUE READING", small abstract document thumbnail, "The Art of Attention", "Page 42 of 180", and one right-arrow button. It is compact, only about 110dp tall, leaving room for files.
Row of filter chips "All", "PDFs", "Articles", "Images". Beneath them "Your documents" left and "Newest" with sort icon right.
Four tidy generous list rows, separated by hairlines rather than boxed individual cards. Each row has a real-looking original document thumbnail on the left, two-line readable title and metadata, and three-dot overflow on the right. Rows:
"The Art of Attention" — "PDF · 180 pages" — subtle slim saved-location line;
"A Field Guide to Nature" — "PDF · 96 pages";
"Ideas Worth Keeping" — "Article · 8 pages";
"Weekend Notes" — "Image · 1 page".
Use modest color in thumbnails only, no giant illustrations. Bottom navigation Library / Voices / Settings, blue active Library. No active media bar.
Outside phone at top: "B  MODERN FOCUS". Visually sharp, organized, efficient, not cramped. Large enough type and touch targets for everyday Android use.

Direction C: Night Reader. A listening-focused dark home screen, unmistakably different layout from A and B. Deep charcoal #141B1A background, layered dark olive surfaces #232E28, warm off-white text, muted sage #B8D7B0 accent, no pure black glare or neon. Sophisticated editorial typography with a warm serif display heading and clean readable sans utility text. Absolutely no glassmorphism, glow or excessive gradients.
Layout top-to-bottom:
Android status bar. Header "Read Assist" with a small rounded "＋ Add" outline action. Large heading "Your reading space". Small search icon or a low-height search field "Search your library".
One dominant, beautiful horizontal listening feature taking about 35 percent of usable screen: micro-label "READY TO CONTINUE", a large original abstract terracotta/cream cover "The Art of Attention" alongside clean text "The Art of Attention", "Page 42 of 180". A slim sage progress line. Along the card bottom a sage rounded button with a play icon and label "Listen", plus a secondary text button "Open page". These are large, comfortable, medium-sized controls, not a full audio dashboard. Only one set of playback controls on the screen.
Below, "Your documents" header with small filter icon, then filter chips "All", "PDFs", "Articles", "Images". Two compact horizontally arranged document tiles with mini covers and full readable titles "A Field Guide to Nature" / "Ideas Worth Keeping", metadata "PDF · 96 pages" / "Article · 8 pages". Small overflow actions. Use rich subdued cover colors, crisp high contrast.
Bottom navigation Library / Voices / Settings, sage active Library. No duplicated Home tab, no persistent extra media strip, no reading statistics.
Outside phone at top: "C  NIGHT READER". Dark proposal shown on a neutral muted charcoal presentation background; device still fully outlined and identifiable. Elegant and usable rather than cinematic concept art.
